parts.stem:
Farida and Sameh have collected some sand, silt, and clay soil. They want to test each of the soils for rising of water in soil.

Put the steps of the method into the correct order.

items.value: Observe how high the water rises in each of the three tubes.
Immerse the three covered ends of the tubes at equal depths in a basin of water.
Tightly cover one end of each tube with a cloth.
Add an equal amount of each soil to each tube separately.
Collect three similar glass tubes with openings at both ends.

correct_answer: Collect three similar glass tubes with openings at both ends.
Tightly cover one end of each tube with a cloth.
Add an equal amount of each soil to each tube separately.
Immerse the three covered ends of the tubes at equal depths in a basin of water.
Observe how high the water rises in each of the three tubes.
